name: Wannabe Challenge
source:
I, a prominent fashion model, hereby declare to run away from home!
But before I can even move out, 4 strange men appear in my life!
How will this unexpected rendezvous with 4 guys unravel?

Join a fashion contest "Wannabe Challenge" with the goblins!
Many unforeseen events and heart-throbbing romance with hidden fates await you.

Who's the love of your life and fate?
Your romance starts from your fingertips!
Join the Wannabe Challenge now!
translation:
身为知名时装模特的我，在此宣布要离家出走！
可还没来得及搬走，四个奇怪的男人就出现在我的生活中！
与他们这场出乎意料的邂逅，将如何发展？

与鬼怪们一起参加时尚比赛“挑战WANNABE”！
许多意料之外的事件、令人心动的恋情，以及隐藏的命运，正在等着你。

谁才是你一生的挚爱与命中注定？
浪漫，由指尖开始！
现在就加入挑战WANNABE！
